story: In the winter of 1126 the Jurchen Jin besieged Kaifeng, the Northern Song capital. The retired emperor Huizong and his son Emperor Qinzong tried to buy peace with huge payments of gold, silver and silk. In early 1127 the Jin took the city and sacked it.

The Jin carried off both emperors, thousands of members of the imperial clan, palace women, officials and craftsmen to the north. The emperors spent the rest of their lives in captivity in Manchuria. One prince, Zhao Gou, was away from the capital. He was enthroned at Yingtianfu (Shangqiu) as Emperor Gaozong. Pursued by Jin armies, he soon retreated south of the Yangtze, and the Southern Song began.
story_zh: 1126年冬，金军围攻北宋都城开封。已经退位的宋徽宗和他的儿子宋钦宗想用大量金银绢帛换取和平，但没能奏效。1127年初，金军攻破开封，城中遭到洗劫。
金军把徽、钦二帝连同数千名宗室、后妃、官员和工匠押往北方，两位皇帝从此再也没能回来，最终死在东北。当时康王赵构恰好不在京城，他在应天府（今河南商丘）即位，就是宋高宗，不久又退到长江以南，南宋由此开始。
jingkang.why: The fall of Kaifeng split China between the Jin in the north and the Song in the south for more than a century. 'The shame of Jingkang' became a rallying cry for those who wanted to win back the north.
jingkang.why_zh: 开封陷落后，中国南北分裂一百多年，北方属金，南方属宋。"靖康耻"成了主战派念念不忘的口号。

people.name: Zhao Gou
people.role: Emperor Gaozong, founder of the Southern Song

quote.zh: 靖康耻，犹未雪；臣子恨，何时灭。
quote.en: The shame of Jingkang is not yet avenged; when will the anger of His Majesty's servants die away?
quote.from: Man Jiang Hong, traditionally attributed to Yue Fei 满江红

story: In 1129 and 1130 the Jin general Wuzhu (Wanyan Zongbi) led a raid deep into the south. He chased Emperor Gaozong from city to city, forcing him to flee by sea, and plundered Hangzhou. Loaded with loot, Wuzhu then turned back north.

When he reached the Yangtze near Zhenjiang, the Song general Han Shizhong was waiting with a fleet of large warships. Han's wife, Liang Hongyu, is said to have beaten the war drums herself. The Jin boats were driven into Huangtiandang, a dead-end stretch of water near Nanjing, and trapped for 48 days. In the end Wuzhu escaped by digging a canal and attacking the Song ships with fire arrows on a windless day.
story_zh: 1129年至1130年，金将兀术（完颜宗弼）率军深入江南。他一路追赶宋高宗，逼得高宗逃到海上，又洗劫了杭州。之后兀术满载战利品北返。
兀术退到镇江一带的长江边时，韩世忠已经率领大型战船在此等候，相传韩世忠的夫人梁红玉亲自擂鼓助战。金军船队被逼进南京附近的黄天荡，一困就是四十八天。最后兀术命人连夜开凿河道，又趁无风之日用火箭焚烧宋船，才得以脱身。
huangtiandang.why: Although Wuzhu escaped, the battle showed the Jin that crossing the Yangtze was dangerous, and they never raided so far south again.
huangtiandang.why_zh: 兀术虽然逃脱，但此战让金军认识到渡江作战的风险，此后再也没有深入江南。

story: After years of flight from Jin raids, Emperor Gaozong settled his court at Hangzhou, which was renamed Lin'an. In 1138 it became the capital in practice, though officially it was only a 'temporary residence' while the Song still hoped to return to Kaifeng.

Lin'an grew fast. Its population passed a million, swollen by refugees from the north. Canals, markets and teahouses filled the city, and night markets ran until dawn. Paper money, printed books and goods from Southeast Asia passed through its streets. West Lake, with its gardens and temples, became a place of leisure for officials and merchants alike. Later visitors such as Marco Polo described it as the finest city in the world.
story_zh: 为躲避金兵追击，宋高宗辗转多年，最终把朝廷安顿在杭州，并改名临安。1138年，临安成了事实上的都城，不过名义上只是"行在"，表示朝廷仍盼着有一天回到开封。
临安发展得很快。大批北方难民南下，城中人口超过百万。城里河道纵横，市场、茶坊林立，夜市一直开到天亮，纸币、刻本书籍和南洋货物在这里流通。西湖边园林寺庙遍布，官员和商人都爱来此游赏。后来马可·波罗等外国人把它称为世界上最美的城市。
linan.why: Lin'an showed how far the economic center of China had moved to the south. It stayed the Song capital until the Mongols took it in 1276.
linan.why_zh: 临安的繁荣说明中国的经济重心已经南移。直到1276年被元军攻占，它一直是南宋的都城。

people.name: Emperor Gaozong
people.role: Emperor who made Lin'an the capital

story: In 1140 the Jin broke an earlier peace treaty and sent Wuzhu south again. Yue Fei's army, based in the middle Yangtze, counterattacked into Henan and retook several cities. Near Yancheng, Wuzhu threw his best heavy cavalry at Yue Fei's forces.

According to Song accounts, Yue Fei's infantry used long axes and blades to cut at the horses' legs, and his son Yue Yun led the charge. The Jin cavalry was broken. A few days later another victory followed at nearby Yingchang. Yue Fei's vanguard reached Zhuxian, only about 20 kilometers from Kaifeng. Then a series of orders from the court, traditionally said to be twelve gold plaques in one day, called him back.
story_zh: 1140年，金朝撕毁此前的和约，再派兀术南下。驻守长江中游的岳飞率军北上反击，进入河南，收复多座城池。在郾城附近，兀术派出最精锐的重装骑兵进攻岳家军。
据宋人记载，岳家军步兵手持长斧、大刀专砍马腿，岳飞之子岳云率先冲阵，金军骑兵大败。几天后，岳家军又在附近的颍昌取胜，前锋一直打到离开封只有二十多公里的朱仙镇。就在这时，朝廷连续下令召他回师，传说一天之内来了十二道金牌。
yancheng.why: Yancheng marked the high point of Song efforts to retake the north. The recall that followed is one of the most lamented decisions in Chinese history.
yancheng.why_zh: 郾城之战是南宋收复北方最有希望的时刻。随后的班师令成了中国历史上最令人惋惜的决定之一。

story: Yue Fei rose from a poor farming family to become the most successful Song general against the Jin. In 1140 his army advanced deep into Henan and won battles near Kaifeng. The emperor and chief minister Qin Hui, however, wanted peace and ordered him and other generals to withdraw.

In 1141 Yue Fei was stripped of his command and jailed on charges of plotting rebellion. When the general Han Shizhong asked Qin Hui for the evidence, Qin replied that it 'may have been' true. Early in 1142 Yue Fei died in prison, and his son Yue Yun was executed. The Treaty of Shaoxing then fixed the border at the Huai River, and the Song agreed to pay the Jin yearly tribute.
story_zh: 岳飞出身贫寒农家，后来成为南宋抗金战功最大的将领。1140年，他率军深入河南，在开封附近连战连捷。可是宋高宗和宰相秦桧一心求和，下令岳飞等将领撤军。
1141年，岳飞被解除兵权，以谋反罪名下狱。韩世忠去质问秦桧有什么证据，秦桧回答"莫须有"。1142年初，岳飞死于狱中，儿子岳云也被处死。随后宋金订立绍兴和议，以淮河为界，南宋每年向金交纳岁币。
yue-fei.why: Yue Fei became China's model of loyalty and patriotism, and Qin Hui its model traitor. The peace he died for held the border for twenty years.
yue-fei.why_zh: 岳飞成了中国人心中忠诚报国的典范，秦桧则成了奸臣的代名词。用他的死换来的和约让边境安定了约二十年。

people.name: Qin Hui
people.role: Chief minister who made peace with Jin

quote.zh: 桧曰：“飞子云与张宪书虽不明，其事体莫须有。”世忠曰：“‘莫须有’三字，何以服天下？”
quote.en: Qin Hui said: 'Though the letter is unclear, the matter may have been so.' Han Shizhong replied: 'How can the words "may have been" convince the world?'

story: The Jin dynasty started in Manchuria, with its capital at Shangjing near today's Harbin. After conquering northern China it ruled millions of Han Chinese far to the south. Wanyan Liang, who seized the throne in 1150 and is known as Prince Hailing, wanted to rule as a Chinese-style emperor.

He rebuilt the old Liao southern capital at Yanjing on the model of Kaifeng and moved the court there in 1153, renaming it Zhongdu, the 'central capital'. He later ordered the palaces of Shangjing torn down. Zhongdu grew into a large city with walls about 18 kilometers around. It remained the Jin capital until the Mongol attacks of 1214 and 1215.
story_zh: 金朝起源于东北，最初的都城上京会宁府在今天哈尔滨附近。灭北宋后，金朝统治着南方广大地区的大量汉人。1150年夺得皇位的完颜亮，也就是海陵王，一心想做一个中原式的皇帝。
他仿照开封的格局，扩建原来辽朝的南京（燕京），1153年把朝廷迁到这里，改名中都，后来又下令拆毁上京的宫殿。中都城周长约十八公里，成为一座大城，此后一直是金朝的都城，直到1214至1215年蒙古大举进攻。
jin-zhongdu.why: Zhongdu was the first time Beijing served as the main capital of a dynasty. The Yuan, Ming and Qing all later ruled from the same area.
jin-zhongdu.why_zh: 中都是北京第一次作为王朝的正式都城。此后元、明、清三朝都在这里建都。

story: Paper money began in Sichuan in the Northern Song, where iron coins were too heavy to carry. In the Southern Song, merchants in Lin'an issued their own paper notes. In 1160 the government took over this business and began printing official notes called huizi, backed by its stores of coins and silver.

Huizi notes came in several values and could be used to pay taxes. At first they were limited to a few regions and had to be renewed every three years. They became popular across the south. But the costs of war with the Jin and then the Mongols led the government to print more and more notes, and by the last decades of the dynasty their value had collapsed.
story_zh: 纸币最早出现在北宋时期的四川，因为当地使用的铁钱太重，携带不便。南宋时，临安的商人也自行发行纸质票据。1160年，朝廷把这项业务收归官办，开始印行会子，以库存的铜钱和白银作为准备。
会子面额有好几种，可以用来缴纳赋税。起初只在部分地区流通，每三年换发一次，后来在南方各地广泛使用。可是对金和对蒙古的战争开支巨大，朝廷不断加印，到南宋末年会子已经严重贬值。
huizi.why: The huizi was one of the world's first large-scale government paper currencies, and its fate showed early on the danger of printing money to pay for war.
huizi.why_zh: 会子是世界上最早大规模发行的官方纸币之一，它的命运也很早就显示出靠印钞支付战费的危险。

story: In 1161 the Jin ruler Wanyan Liang (Prince Hailing) broke the peace and led a huge army south to conquer the Song. He reached the north bank of the Yangtze near Caishi, upstream from Nanjing, and prepared to cross.

The Song commander there had just left, and the troops had no leader. Yu Yunwen, a civil official sent to reward the army, took charge. He organized the soldiers and used fast paddle-wheel warships and thunderclap bombs, gunpowder weapons thrown by trebuchet, against the Jin boats. The Jin crossing failed with heavy losses. A few weeks later Wanyan Liang was murdered by his own officers, and the Jin army went home.
story_zh: 1161年，金朝皇帝完颜亮（海陵王）撕毁和约，亲率大军南下，想一举灭宋。他抵达南京上游采石一带的长江北岸，准备渡江。
当时宋军主将刚刚离任，军中无人指挥。奉命前来犒军的文官虞允文挺身而出，把士兵重新组织起来，用灵活的车船和抛石机发射的霹雳炮迎击金军船队。金军渡江失败。几周后，完颜亮被部下所杀，金军撤回北方。
caishi.why: The victory saved the Southern Song from conquest and is one of the earliest battles in which gunpowder weapons played a key role.
caishi.why_zh: 这场胜利使南宋免于覆亡，也是火药武器在战争中发挥关键作用的早期战例之一。

people.name: Yu Yunwen
people.role: Song official who led the defense

story: Emperor Gaozong abdicated in 1162 in favor of his adopted son, who became Emperor Xiaozong. The new emperor wanted to recover the north and restored Yue Fei's honors. In 1163 he sent the general Zhang Jun's forces, led in the field by Li Xianzhong, across the Huai River.

The Song army took Lingbi and Suzhou, but its commanders quarreled and soldiers were angry over unequal rewards. When a Jin relief army arrived, the Song troops panicked and broke near Fuli. In 1164 the two sides signed the Longxing Peace. The Song emperor no longer called himself a subject of the Jin, and the yearly tribute was reduced, but the border stayed where it was.
story_zh: 1162年，宋高宗退位，养子即位，就是宋孝宗。孝宗有意收复中原，还为岳飞平反昭雪。1163年，他命张浚主持北伐，由李显忠等将领率军渡过淮河。
宋军先攻下灵璧、宿州，但将领之间互相猜忌，士兵也因赏赐不公而不满。金军援兵一到，宋军在符离一带溃散。1164年双方订立隆兴和议：南宋皇帝不再对金称臣，岁币也有所减少，但边界维持不变。
fuli.why: After Fuli, the Southern Song and Jin lived in peace for about forty years, a time of prosperity in the south.
fuli.why_zh: 符离之败后，宋金之间维持了约四十年的和平，南方经济在这段时间里十分繁荣。

story: In 1175 the scholar Lü Zuqian invited Zhu Xi and the brothers Lu Jiuyuan and Lu Jiuling to meet at the Goose Lake Temple in eastern Jiangxi. He hoped the leading thinkers of the day could settle their differences about how to become a good person.

Zhu Xi argued that one must study widely and examine things one by one to understand the principles behind them. Lu Jiuyuan argued that the moral mind is already complete inside everyone, and that one should first discover it, not get lost in book learning. The Lu brothers recited poems mocking Zhu's method as fragmented. After several days neither side gave way, and the meeting ended without agreement.
story_zh: 1175年，学者吕祖谦邀请朱熹和陆九龄、陆九渊兄弟到江西东北部的鹅湖寺相会，希望当时最有名的几位思想家能在"如何成圣成贤"这个问题上达成一致。
朱熹主张广泛读书，逐一考察事物，才能明白其中的道理；陆九渊则认为，道德本心人人具足，应当先发明本心，而不是埋头于书本。陆氏兄弟当场赋诗，讥讽朱熹的方法支离破碎。双方辩论了好几天，谁也没有说服谁，最后不欢而散。
goose-lake.why: The debate marked the split in Neo-Confucianism between Zhu Xi's 'school of principle' and the 'school of mind', which Wang Yangming later carried forward.
goose-lake.why_zh: 这场辩论标志着理学内部的分野：一边是朱熹的"理学"，一边是陆九渊的"心学"，后来由王阳明发扬光大。

quote.zh: 易简工夫终久大，支离事业竟浮沉。
quote.en: The simple and easy way will in the end be great; fragmented labors will only drift and sink.
quote.from: Lu Jiuyuan, poem at Goose Lake 陆九渊《鹅湖和教授兄韵》

story: Zhu Xi spent decades writing commentaries on four short Confucian classics: the Analects, the Mencius, the Great Learning and the Doctrine of the Mean. He treated these 'Four Books' as the core of Confucian teaching and explained them through his philosophy of principle (li).

In 1190, while serving as prefect of Zhangzhou in Fujian, he had the complete work printed, known as the Collected Commentaries on the Four Books. He kept revising it until his death in 1200. During his last years his teachings were banned, but the ban was soon lifted. In 1313 the Yuan dynasty made his commentary the standard for the imperial examinations, and it remained so until 1905.
story_zh: 朱熹花了几十年时间，为《论语》《孟子》《大学》《中庸》四部儒家典籍作注。他把这"四书"视为儒学的核心，并用自己的"理"学加以阐释。
1190年，朱熹在福建漳州任知州时，把全书刻印出来，这就是《四书章句集注》。此后他一直修改，直到1200年去世。他晚年学说曾遭禁止，但禁令很快解除。1313年，元朝规定科举以他的注释为标准，这一做法一直延续到1905年。
four-books.why: For about 600 years every Chinese candidate for office had to learn the Four Books through Zhu Xi's reading, which shaped the thinking of the whole educated class, and of Korea and Japan too.
four-books.why_zh: 此后约六百年间，中国的读书人参加科举都必须按照朱熹的解释学习四书，这深刻塑造了整个士人阶层的思想，也影响了朝鲜和日本。

story: In 1194 the official Zhao Ruyu and the imperial in-law Han Tuozhou helped put Emperor Ningzong on the throne. The two men soon fell out. Han won, and Zhao, who had brought Zhu Xi to court as a lecturer to the emperor, was sent away and died in exile.

Han and his allies then attacked Zhu Xi's school, calling it 'false learning'. In 1197 they published a blacklist of 59 officials and scholars said to belong to a 'false party'. Followers of Zhu Xi were barred from office, and examination candidates had to state they did not study his works. Zhu Xi died in 1200 under the ban. It was relaxed in 1202.
story_zh: 1194年，宗室大臣赵汝愚和外戚韩侂胄合力拥立宋宁宗即位。两人随后发生冲突，韩侂胄占了上风。曾举荐朱熹入朝为皇帝讲学的赵汝愚被贬，死在贬所。
韩侂胄一派接着打击朱熹的学派，称之为"伪学"。1197年，朝廷公布"伪学逆党"名单，列入五十九人。朱熹的门人不得做官，参加科举的人还要声明自己不学伪学。1200年，朱熹在党禁中去世。1202年禁令放宽。
qingyuan-ban.why: The ban failed. After Han Tuozhou's fall, Zhu Xi's teachings were honored by the court and became state orthodoxy.
qingyuan-ban.why_zh: 这次党禁并没有成功。韩侂胄倒台后，朱熹的学说受到朝廷推崇，最终成为官方正统。

story: Temüjin was born around 1162 into a minor Mongol noble family. His father was poisoned when he was a boy, and his family was abandoned. Through alliances, loyal followers and victories over rival tribes he gradually united the peoples of the steppe.

In 1206 a great assembly, the kurultai, met near the source of the Onon River and proclaimed him Genghis Khan, ruler of all the Mongols. He organized his people into units of tens, hundreds and thousands, gave them a written law and adopted a script. Within a few years he attacked Western Xia and then the Jin. Before his death in 1227 his armies had also reached Central Asia and Persia.
story_zh: 铁木真大约生于1162年，出身蒙古一个小贵族家庭。他年幼时父亲被毒死，一家人遭部众抛弃。此后他靠结盟、收拢忠心的部下、击败敌对部落，逐步统一了草原各部。
1206年，蒙古各部在斡难河源头召开大会，推举他为成吉思汗，即全蒙古的大汗。他把百姓编成十户、百户、千户，颁布法令，并采用文字。几年之内，他先后进攻西夏和金朝。到1227年去世时，他的军队已经打到中亚和波斯。
genghis.why: Genghis Khan founded the Mongol Empire, which became the largest land empire in history and later conquered all of China.
genghis.why_zh: 成吉思汗建立的蒙古帝国后来成为历史上疆域最大的陆上帝国，并最终征服了整个中国。

story: By the early 1200s the Jin was weakened by floods, unrest and the rising Mongols to its north. Han Tuozhou, who controlled the Song court, hoped a victory in the north would strengthen his position. He honored Yue Fei with a posthumous royal title and stripped Qin Hui of his honors.

In 1206, during the Kaixi reign, Song armies attacked along the Huai River. They were poorly prepared. Several attacks failed quickly, and the Jin counterattacked across the Huai. Worse, the Song commander in Sichuan, Wu Xi, defected to the Jin and declared himself king of Shu. He was killed by his own officers within a few months, but the war was clearly lost.
story_zh: 到13世纪初，金朝受水灾、民变和北方蒙古崛起的困扰，国力衰退。掌控南宋朝政的韩侂胄希望靠北伐立功来巩固地位。他追封岳飞为鄂王，又剥夺了秦桧的封号。
1206年，正值开禧年间，宋军沿淮河一线发动进攻。由于准备不足，几路进攻很快失利，金军反过来渡过淮河南下。更糟的是，驻守四川的宋将吴曦投降金朝，自称蜀王。几个月后他被部下杀死，但这场战争已注定失败。
kaixi.why: The failed campaign cost Han Tuozhou his life and left the Song with a harsher peace, just as the Mongols were about to change the whole region.
kaixi.why_zh: 北伐的失败让韩侂胄丢了性命，南宋也被迫接受更苛刻的和约，而此时蒙古正要改变整个地区的格局。

people.name: Han Tuozhou
people.role: Chief minister who started the war

story: As the Kaixi war went badly, the Jin demanded the head of the man who started it. In late 1207 a group of officials led by Shi Miyuan, with the support of the empress, had Han Tuozhou ambushed and killed on his way to court.

In 1208 the Song signed the Peace of Jiading. Han's head was lacquered and sent to the Jin. The yearly payments to the Jin rose to 300,000 taels of silver and 300,000 bolts of silk, and the Song paid a large war indemnity. The relationship between the rulers was changed to that of nephew and uncle. Shi Miyuan then dominated the Song government for the next 25 years.
story_zh: 开禧北伐节节失利，金朝要求南宋交出发动战争的人的首级。1207年底，史弥远等官员在皇后支持下，于韩侂胄上朝途中将他截杀。
1208年，宋金订立嘉定和议。韩侂胄的首级被涂漆后送往金朝；南宋每年给金的岁币增加到银、绢各三十万，另外还要支付一大笔犒军钱，两国皇帝改称伯侄。此后史弥远独揽南宋朝政长达二十五年。
jiading-peace.why: The humiliating peace showed how weak the Song had become, though the Jin soon had far bigger problems with the Mongols.
jiading-peace.why_zh: 这份屈辱的和约暴露了南宋的虚弱，不过金朝很快就面临来自蒙古的更大威胁。

story: Genghis Khan began his war on the Jin in 1211 and won a crushing victory at Yehuling, north of Zhongdu. Over the next years his armies raided across northern China. In 1214 the Jin emperor Xuanzong made peace by giving the Mongols a princess and much tribute, then moved his court south to Kaifeng.

Genghis saw the move as a breach of the peace and sent his armies back. Zhongdu was besieged and starved, and in the summer of 1215 it fell. The city was looted and much of it burned, and the fires reportedly lasted for a month. Many Jin officials joined the Mongols, among them the Khitan scholar Yelü Chucai, who later served Genghis as an adviser.
story_zh: 1211年，成吉思汗开始进攻金朝，在中都北面的野狐岭大败金军。此后几年，蒙古军在华北各地反复劫掠。1214年，金宣宗献出公主和大量财物求和，随后把朝廷南迁到开封。
成吉思汗认为金朝迁都是背约之举，再次派兵南下。中都被围，城中断粮，1215年夏天陷落。蒙古军洗劫全城，大片城区被焚，据说大火烧了一个多月。许多金朝官员投降蒙古，其中就有契丹学者耶律楚材，他后来成了成吉思汗的谋士。
zhongdu-falls.why: The fall of Zhongdu gave the Mongols the north China plain and left the Jin a shrinking state around Kaifeng.
zhongdu-falls.why_zh: 攻陷中都后，蒙古控制了华北平原，金朝只剩下以开封为中心、日益缩小的地盘。

people.name: Yelü Chucai
people.role: Khitan official who joined the Mongols

story: Under the Southern Song, sea trade grew more important than ever. Quanzhou in Fujian became one of the busiest ports in the world, with merchants from Arabia, Persia, India and Southeast Asia living there. The government taxed the trade through a maritime trade office.

Zhao Rugua, a member of the imperial clan, ran this office in Quanzhou. He questioned foreign merchants and sailors and in 1225 finished a book called Zhu Fan Zhi, the 'Description of Foreign Peoples'. The first part describes dozens of countries, from Japan and Java to Arabia and the coast of East Africa. The second part lists trade goods such as frankincense, ivory, pearls and spices, and where they came from.
story_zh: 南宋时期，海上贸易比以往任何时候都重要。福建泉州成为世界上最繁忙的港口之一，城里住着来自阿拉伯、波斯、印度和东南亚的商人。朝廷通过市舶司对海外贸易征税。
宗室出身的赵汝适曾在泉州主管市舶事务。他向外国商人和水手打听各地情况，于1225年写成《诸蕃志》。上卷记载从日本、爪哇到阿拉伯和东非沿岸的几十个国家，下卷记录乳香、象牙、珍珠、香料等货物及其产地。
zhao-rugua.why: Zhao's book is a key source on the medieval Indian Ocean trade, and shows how widely Chinese merchants and officials knew the wider world.
zhao-rugua.why_zh: 《诸蕃志》是研究中世纪印度洋贸易的重要史料，也说明当时中国商人和官员对外部世界已有相当广泛的了解。

story: Western Xia, the state of the Tangut people in today's Ningxia and Gansu, had submitted to Genghis Khan in 1210. When Genghis asked for troops for his campaign against the Khwarazm Empire in Central Asia, the Tanguts refused. After returning, Genghis led a punishing war against them in 1226.

The Mongols took city after city and besieged the capital, Zhongxing (Yinchuan). During the campaign, in August 1227, Genghis Khan died; the cause is still debated. Following his orders, his death was kept secret until the Tangut ruler surrendered. The ruler was then killed anyway, and much of the Tangut population of the capital was massacred. The 190-year-old Western Xia state ended.
story_zh: 西夏是党项人建立的国家，位于今天的宁夏、甘肃一带。1210年它曾臣服于成吉思汗，但当成吉思汗西征中亚的花剌子模、要求西夏出兵时，西夏拒绝了。成吉思汗西征归来后，于1226年亲率大军讨伐西夏。
蒙古军接连攻下多座城池，包围了都城中兴府（今银川）。1227年8月，成吉思汗在军中去世，死因至今仍有争议。按照他的遗命，死讯一直秘而不宣，直到西夏末主出城投降。末主随即被杀，大批党项人遭到屠戮，立国约一百九十年的西夏就此灭亡。
western-xia-falls.why: The fall of Western Xia removed a buffer state on the northwest and almost erased Tangut culture, whose script was only decoded in modern times.
western-xia-falls.why_zh: 西夏灭亡后，西北的缓冲国不复存在，党项文化几乎被抹去，西夏文直到近代才被重新解读。

story: After years of Mongol attacks, the Jin had lost the north and its capital Kaifeng. In 1233 the last emperor, Aizong, fled to Caizhou in southern Henan. A Mongol army under the general Tachar besieged the town, and the Song sent an army under Meng Gong to join them in return for a promise of land.

In early 1234 the walls fell. Aizong passed the throne to a general, Wanyan Chenglin, and hanged himself. Chenglin was killed in the street fighting the same day, ending the Jin dynasty after 120 years. The Song carried Aizong's remains back to Lin'an and offered them at the imperial ancestral temple as revenge for the Jingkang Incident.
story_zh: 经过蒙古多年进攻，金朝已经丢掉北方和都城开封。1233年，金哀宗逃到河南南部的蔡州。蒙古军随即围城，南宋也派孟珙率军前来会攻，条件是战后分给南宋土地。
1234年初，蔡州城破。金哀宗把皇位传给将领完颜承麟后自缢身亡，完颜承麟当天也死于巷战，立国一百二十年的金朝就此灭亡。南宋把哀宗的遗骨带回临安，献于太庙，算是报了靖康之仇。
caizhou.why: Destroying the Jin removed the buffer between Song and the Mongols. Within a year they were at war, a war that ended with the fall of the Song.
caizhou.why_zh: 金朝灭亡后，南宋与蒙古之间再无缓冲。不到一年双方就开战，这场战争最终以南宋灭亡告终。

story: After the fall of Jin in early 1234, the Mongol armies pulled back north, leaving Henan devastated and nearly empty. Officials at the Song court, led by the new chief minister Zheng Qingzhi, saw a chance to retake the three old capitals: Kaifeng, Luoyang and Shangqiu.

In the summer of 1234, during the Duanping reign, Song troops marched in and entered Kaifeng, then sent a force on to Luoyang. They found ruined cities with no food, and their supply lines were long. A Mongol army ambushed the troops near Luoyang, and the Song forces retreated in disorder. The Mongols treated the advance as an attack, and in 1235 they began a full war on the Song.
story_zh: 1234年初金朝灭亡后，蒙古军北撤，河南一带经过战乱，几乎成了一片荒地。以新任宰相郑清之为首的南宋朝臣，认为这是收复开封、洛阳、商丘三京的好机会。
1234年夏天，也就是端平元年，宋军北上进入开封，又分兵前往洛阳。可是他们看到的只是残破的空城，粮草无处筹措，补给线又拉得很长。蒙古军在洛阳附近设伏，宋军大败南撤。蒙古把这次行动视为挑衅，1235年起全面进攻南宋。
duanping.why: The failed march began the forty-five-year war between the Mongols and the Song that ended with the fall of the dynasty.
duanping.why_zh: 这次失败的出兵拉开了宋蒙之间长达四十五年战争的序幕，最终以南宋灭亡告终。

story: In 1240 Mongol troops sent by Prince Köden, a grandson of Genghis Khan who governed the Gansu region, raided central Tibet. Köden then invited the most respected Tibetan religious leader, Sakya Pandita of the Sakya school, to his camp.

Sakya Pandita, then in his sixties, set out on the long journey north with his young nephews Phagpa and Chakna, a trip that took about two years. He reached Liangzhou and met Köden in 1247. They agreed that Tibet would accept Mongol overlordship, while the Sakya lamas would act for the Mongols in Tibet. Sakya Pandita wrote a famous letter urging Tibetan leaders to submit. He stayed in Liangzhou, teaching and treating the prince's illness, and died there in 1251.
story_zh: 1240年，统治河西一带的蒙古王子阔端（成吉思汗之孙）派兵进入西藏中部。随后，阔端邀请藏传佛教萨迦派的领袖萨迦班智达前来会面。
年过六旬的萨迦班智达带着两个年幼的侄子八思巴和恰那上路，历时约两年，1247年在凉州见到了阔端。双方商定：吐蕃归附蒙古，由萨迦派代表蒙古管理当地事务。萨迦班智达还写了一封著名的公开信，劝吐蕃各地首领归顺。他此后留在凉州，1251年在那里去世。
liangzhou-meeting.why: The meeting began the political link between Tibet and the Mongol court, which the Yuan dynasty later turned into direct administration.
liangzhou-meeting.why_zh: 这次会面开启了西藏与蒙古朝廷的政治联系，后来元朝在此基础上直接管理西藏。

story: Qin Jiushao was a Song official from Sichuan with wide interests: astronomy, music, architecture and above all mathematics. While at home in Huzhou mourning his mother, he finished a book in 1247 called the Mathematical Treatise in Nine Sections.

Its 81 problems cover practical topics such as taxes, granaries, building, military supplies and the calendar. Two methods stand out. One is a general way to solve problems of remainders, now known as the Chinese remainder theorem, which Qin called the 'great expansion' method. The other is a step-by-step way to find numerical roots of equations of high degree, similar to the method published by William Horner in England in 1819.
story_zh: 秦九韶是四川人，在南宋做官，兴趣十分广泛，懂天文、音律、营造，尤其擅长数学。1247年，他在湖州为母亲守丧期间，写成了《数书九章》。
书中八十一道题，涉及赋税、粮仓、建筑、军需、历法等实际问题。其中两种方法尤其突出：一是解一次同余方程组的"大衍求一术"，也就是今天所说的中国剩余定理；二是用逐步逼近求高次方程数值解的"正负开方术"，与英国人霍纳1819年发表的方法相似。
qin-jiushao.why: Qin's book is a high point of Chinese mathematics, solving problems that European mathematicians would not tackle for centuries.
qin-jiushao.why_zh: 《数书九章》是中国古代数学的高峰之一，书中解决的问题欧洲数学家要到几百年后才着手研究。

story: Song Ci was a Song official from Fujian who served for many years as a judicial inspector in several circuits, reviewing criminal cases. He found that many wrong judgments came from careless examination of bodies.

In 1247, while serving as judicial commissioner in Hunan, he finished the Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified (Xi Yuan Ji Lu). It drew on earlier works and his own experience. The book explains how to examine a body step by step, how to tell drowning from a body thrown into water after death, how to recognize poisoning, strangling and wounds made before or after death. It also gives first aid for hanging and drowning victims.
story_zh: 宋慈是福建人，曾在多个路担任提点刑狱，负责复核刑事案件。他发现很多冤案都是因为验尸草率造成的。
1247年，他在湖南提刑任上写成《洗冤集录》。这部书参考前人著作，结合自己多年的经验，讲解如何一步步检验尸体：怎样分辨生前溺水和死后抛尸，怎样识别中毒、勒死，怎样判断伤口是生前还是死后造成的。书中还记载了上吊、溺水者的急救方法。
song-ci.why: The book was used by Chinese officials for 600 years, was translated into many languages, and is often called the world's first forensic science textbook.
song-ci.why_zh: 此书在中国沿用了六百年，被译成多种文字，常被称为世界上第一部法医学专著。

story: In 1258 the Great Khan Möngke launched a three-pronged invasion of the Song. He himself led the main army into Sichuan, while his brother Kublai attacked toward Ezhou on the Yangtze.

In 1259 Möngke reached Diaoyu Fortress near Hechuan, a walled town on a steep hill where three rivers meet. The Song commander Wang Jian had stored food and water inside the walls, and the defenders beat back months of attacks. In the summer heat, dysentery and other diseases spread through the crowded Mongol camp. In August Möngke died there, of illness or perhaps of a wound. The Mongol armies pulled back so the princes could decide who would succeed him.
story_zh: 1258年，蒙古大汗蒙哥兵分三路进攻南宋。他亲率主力进入四川，弟弟忽必烈则进攻长江边的鄂州。
1259年，蒙哥来到合川附近的钓鱼城。这座城建在三江交汇处的陡峭山上，守将王坚早已囤积了粮食和水源，守军顶住了蒙古军几个月的猛攻。夏天酷热，蒙古军中疾病流行。8月，蒙哥死在军中，一说病死，一说受伤而亡。各路蒙古军随即撤退，诸王要回去推选新的大汗。
diaoyu.why: Möngke's death gave the Song twenty more years and set off the struggle that made Kublai Great Khan. It also halted the Mongol advance in the Middle East.
diaoyu.why_zh: 蒙哥之死使南宋又延续了二十年，并引发了忽必烈夺取汗位的斗争，也使蒙古在西亚的扩张一度停顿。

story: When Möngke died in 1259, his brother Kublai was besieging Ezhou on the Yangtze. Another brother, Ariq Böke, held the old Mongol capital Karakorum and was gathering support among the princes. Kublai made a quick truce with the Song and hurried north.

In the spring of 1260 Kublai held an assembly at his own base, Kaiping, and was proclaimed Great Khan. A few weeks later Ariq Böke was proclaimed Great Khan at Karakorum. The two fought for four years. Kublai, with the grain and wealth of north China behind him, cut off Karakorum's supplies. In 1264 Ariq Böke, short of food and allies, surrendered. Kublai renamed Kaiping as Shangdu, the upper capital.
story_zh: 1259年蒙哥去世时，忽必烈正在长江边围攻鄂州。另一个弟弟阿里不哥占据蒙古旧都哈拉和林，正在拉拢诸王。忽必烈和南宋匆匆议和，立即北返。
1260年春，忽必烈在自己的大本营开平召开大会，被推举为大汗。几周后，阿里不哥也在哈拉和林称汗。兄弟二人打了四年。忽必烈依靠华北的粮食和财富，切断了哈拉和林的物资供应。1264年阿里不哥投降。忽必烈把开平改名为上都。
kublai-khan-1260.why: Kublai's victory moved the center of Mongol power from the steppe to China. But the empire split, as the western khanates no longer obeyed the Great Khan.
kublai-khan-1260.why_zh: 忽必烈的胜利使蒙古政权的重心从草原移到了中原。但蒙古帝国也从此分裂，西部各汗国不再听命于大汗。

people.name: Kublai Khan
people.role: Great Khan, later founder of Yuan
people.role_zh: 大汗，后来的元朝开国皇帝

story: Kublai had met the young lama Phagpa, Sakya Pandita's nephew, in the 1250s and made him his spiritual teacher. In 1264, after winning the struggle for the throne, Kublai set up a new office in his capital called the Zongzhi Yuan to manage Buddhist affairs across the empire and the government of Tibet, and placed Phagpa at its head.

In 1288 the office was renamed the Xuanzheng Yuan. Phagpa received the title of Imperial Preceptor and designed a new script, the 'Phags-pa script', for writing all the languages of the empire. In Tibet the Sakya lamas ruled with Mongol support, while Yuan officials carried out censuses and set up postal stations.
story_zh: 1250年代，忽必烈结识了萨迦班智达的侄子、年轻的八思巴，拜他为上师。1264年，忽必烈在争夺汗位中胜出后，设立总制院，掌管全国佛教事务和吐蕃地区的政务，由八思巴主持。
1288年，总制院改名为宣政院。八思巴被封为帝师，还奉命创制了一种可以拼写帝国各种语言的新文字。在吐蕃，萨迦派在蒙古支持下掌权，元朝官员则在当地清查户口、设立驿站。
xuanzheng.why: This was the first time a central Chinese government ran Tibetan affairs through a regular office, a precedent later cited in debates over Tibet's status.
xuanzheng.why_zh: 这是中原王朝第一次以常设机构管理西藏事务，后来有关西藏地位的讨论常常援引这一先例。
